rapport_notes: Excellent personal touches (acknowledged the coworker referral), attentive and reassuring on two separate concerns raised.

evidence_quotes.agenda: "before we get all that done, do you have any questions or concerns that you specifically would like answered on this call in regards to the move?" (asked before logistics probing)
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Concrete outdoor table concern got real reassurance (weight limit, lift gate) and a separate refrigerator/door-removal concern got a full answer ('they may just have you sign a liability waiver')
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: adjusted the estimate down based on the customer's own account of a prior similar move: "I've already moved this house once and it took them two hours... we will leave it at four"

top_strength: Genuinely incorporated the customer's own prior-move data point to right-size the estimate instead of just reciting a generic range — exactly the kind of personalization the estimate-anchor item wants.
coaching_note: Neither differentiator was tied directly back to the concrete-table or refrigerator concerns in the moment they were raised — both got logistics answers but the damage-coverage/liability language landed only later in the generic recap.
